Champions are rare, much stronger kin of ordinary monsters. You can tell them by their aura: a blue aura and the title Ultra, a red aura and the title Elite, or, for the strongest of all, a red aura alone.

They have far more HP and hit harder, but give more experience and SP and drop better loot.

Above all, Champions drop the %medal%. Double-click a medal in your inventory to learn a new buff for good. Medals are also the entry fee of the Survival Arena. Keep an eye out for that aura!
